image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference for face/body), lived-in face with subtle fine lines around eyes (no airbrush), shoulder-length warm brown hair tied back loose. Standing in a clean modern Italian bathroom or kitchen at midday natural light. She wears a simple soft heather grey ribbed tank top (NO athletic wear, NO professional outfit - real home).
She holds up an empty hand toward camera in a clear "stop, listen" gesture (palm out, fingers slightly splayed, not aggressive - more like "let me tell you something first"). Her other hand rests on hip naturally.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical shot equivalent, eye level, subject distance 100cm (medium shot chest up), slight 5° forward lean of subject for engagement.
Light: single soft window light from camera-left at 45°, color temperature 5200K (neutral midday), no fill - allow subtle shadow on right side of face for depth and authority.
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo del 'aspetta, prima ascolta questa cosa'" - left eyebrow raised 3mm, mouth in micro-smirk corner left, eyes direct laser camera, NOT pleading NOT aggressive - composed authority of someone with 20 years experience. Slight chin-up tilt (1-2°) for credibility.
Aesthetic reference: NOT Sofia Coppola. NOT cinematic editorial. Reference Italian Instagram coaches Federica Fontana, Carlotta Perego, Cristina Marino for naturalism. Modern Italian fitness coach 2026 Instagram aesthetic - clean, direct, real.
Body: real Italian woman 45, average proportions, real arms (subtle softness on upper arms NOT airbrushed, NOT plus-size styling either), no fitness model symmetry. Just regular Italian woman.
Color grading: neutral white balance + 3% warmth maximum, NO Mediterranean orange, NO golden hour. Slight saturation boost on subject only. Background slightly desaturated.
Composition: rule of thirds, subject center-right (right intersection points), hand-stop gesture in center frame, plenty of clean negative space top 18% for brand banner overlay, bottom 18% for footer.
